The medium-height language is compressed into a sturdy-stocky chibi while retaining Calon’s broad frame, compact proportions, shoulder width, torso mass, leg mass, and natural softness without an armor or muscle upgrade.
Both upper arms, forearms, wrists, and hands retain natural sturdy proportions relative to Calon’s face and torso; neither hand nor arm is ballooned into a generic oversized chibi limb.
The dark-brown gathered wrapped topknot, braided front construction, side shaping, and contrasting marigold band remain clear and source-faithful.

The marigold-green overlapping wrap panels, high soft collar, off-center waist tie, divided trousers, uneven layered hems, soft boots, throat necklace, and one bounded geometric forearm tattoo remain legible and source-bound.

Measured visually from top of hair to chin against top of hair to lowest boot, the complete head-and-hair unit is approximately 40% of standing height, about 2.5 heads total. This exceeds the strict 32–36% band and misses the 34–35% aim.

Exactly one adult appears; the complete topknot, head, both empty hands, layered garment silhouette, both legs, and both boots are fully visible inside generous parchment margins with no duplicated anatomy.
A broad grounded three-quarter ready-idle stance with bent elbows, two empty hands, planted feet, and a clean silhouette reads clearly at combat-icon scale without adding a weapon or attack.
No weapon, attack, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, label, logo, watermark, extra person, or supernatural effect appears.
